addition.item: Added reusable Joomla-style menu controls with dynamic inheritance labels, per-menu themes and true override resets.
Added centralized pagination choices shared by component configuration, views, menus and frontend lists.
Added limit= to embedded CBList views, applied after access checks, filters and sorting and before pagination and export.
Added native DATE, DATETIME, INTEGER, DECIMAL and BOOLEAN controls and validation to direct Storage forms.
Added inline Storage field title, SQL type, size and required-state editing, backed by the 6.1.7.104 schema migration.
Added field and action allow-lists to embedded CBList views.
Added multi-column initial sorting to embedded CBList views via sort=/dir=.
Added a theme switcher to the admin preview banner, alongside the existing layout and colour-mode controls.
Added a CBList actions section to the frontend debug panel, listing which terms apply on each screen and whether each is currently allowed.

change.item: Centralized the active List View Data filter request contract and removed legacy hidden-filter vocabulary from runtime code.
Separated menu-level access restrictions from the Edit button displayed in List View.
Reorganized ContentBuilder menu parameters into clear native Joomla sections and placed List View menu types first.
Consolidated legacy numbered list layouts into the standard List View while retaining Cards, Compact Table and Tiles.
Replaced long list pagination with a compact shared layout showing the first, last and nearby pages without horizontal scrolling.
CBList and CBStats numeric options now require unquoted numeric syntax.
Enabled the repository-wide PSR-12 quality gate and modernized CBStats with strict PHP types.
Direct Storage synchronization now preserves unpublished elements and refreshes native controls when SQL field types change.

fix.item: Made every read-only frontend Edit field immediately identifiable with shared accessible styling and a translated status badge.
Fixed invalid table constructor PHPDoc annotations and replaced a PHP 8.5-deprecated cast.
Fixed Close Preview not closing script-opened Preview tabs in Firefox.
Fixed the View list-limit control not enabling Joomla's Save actions after its value changed.
Preserved selected ContentBuilder views during updates and menu override resets.
Fixed menu translations, encoded group values and inherited or custom list-limit labels.
Fixed the dynamic filter order label rendering as a raw language key in the Joomla Menu Item editor.
Fixed ContentBuilder List menu items reverting to the first published view after a component update.
Updated vulnerable Composer and npm development dependencies to patched compatible releases.
Escaped free-text list and template output to prevent stored cross-site scripting.
Fixed Storage field creation, required-state display, row saving, sorting, system-field publication and schema-audit regressions.
Preserved CBList field and action context across navigation, saves and record actions, and hardened action permission checks.
Fixed a fatal error on front-end list views caused by a missing import in the pagination layout.
Fixed embedded CBList views losing or inverting their sort= order when paging through results.
Fixed upgrading from a version that predates the field_size column aborting during the 6.1.7.104 schema migration.
Fixed some permission-denied messages rendering as untranslated raw keys on the front end.
Fixed the admin Audit panel's repair result message not scrolling into view.
